arStrings.szText: {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}When {c_important}Hurricane{/c} ends or after it lasts {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds, an explosion occurs dealing {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1*100|x%|]{/c} of the total damage dealt by up to {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} hits of {c_important}Hurricane{/c}.{if:SF.IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}
